mapper.select: select count(1) as bill_count, ifnull(sum(total_qty), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as total_amount from wms_inbound where status = '1' and ifnull(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and ifnull(reversed_flag, '0') = '0'

select count(1) as bill_count, ifnull(sum(total_qty), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as total_amount from wms_outbound where status = '1' and ifnull(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and ifnull(reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and ifnull(delivery_status, '0') != '3'

select count(distinct concat(bill_type, '_', bill_id)) as bill_count, ifnull(sum(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as total_amount from wms_stock_log where bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_in', 'inventory_check') and in_out = '1'

select count(distinct concat(bill_type, '_', bill_id)) as bill_count, ifnull(sum(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as total_amount from wms_stock_log where bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_out', 'inventory_check') and in_out = '2'

select inbound_id as bill_id, inbound_no as bill_no, 'inbound' as business_type, total_qty as total_quantity, total_amount as total_amount, create_time as business_time, concat('入库类型:', case ifnull(inbound_type, '') when 'purchase' then '采购入库' when 'return' then '退货入库' when 'other' then '其他入库' else ifnull(inbound_type, '') end) as summary from wms_inbound where status = '1' and ifnull(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and ifnull(reversed_flag, '0') = '0'
order by create_time desc limit #{operationLimit}

select outbound_id as bill_id, outbound_no as bill_no, 'outbound' as business_type, total_qty as total_quantity, total_amount as total_amount, create_time as business_time, concat('出库类型:', case ifnull(outbound_type, '') when 'sale' then '销售出库' when 'return' then '退货出库' when 'other' then '其他出库' else ifnull(outbound_type, '') end) as summary from wms_outbound where status = '1' and ifnull(is_reversal, '0') = '0' and ifnull(reversed_flag, '0') = '0' and ifnull(delivery_status, '0') != '3'
order by create_time desc limit #{operationLimit}

select bill_id, concat(upper(bill_type), '-', bill_id) as bill_no, 'inventory' as business_type, ifnull(sum(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as total_amount, max(create_time) as business_time, concat('库存调整-', case when bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_in') then '调拨入库' when bill_type = 'inventory_check' then '盘点盘盈' else bill_type end) as summary from wms_stock_log where bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_in', 'inventory_check') and in_out = '1'
group by bill_type, bill_id order by business_time desc limit #{operationLimit}

select bill_id, concat(upper(bill_type), '-', bill_id) as bill_no, 'inventory' as business_type, ifnull(sum(quantity), 0) as total_quantity, ifnull(sum(amount), 0) as total_amount, max(create_time) as business_time, concat('库存调整-', case when bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_out') then '调拨出库' when bill_type = 'inventory_check' then '盘点盘亏' else bill_type end) as summary from wms_stock_log where bill_type in ('transfer', 'transfer_out', 'inventory_check') and in_out = '2'
group by bill_type, bill_id order by business_time desc limit #{operationLimit}
